ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Rundll32 - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: Payload

sequences.query: ((Payload = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*shellexec\\_rundll.*")) AND (Payload = RGX(".*value.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*invoke.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*comspec.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*iex.*")))
